label: Q4_1 fused gate+up dense MMVQ
rationale: Q4_1 dense FFN gate+up was unfused — every layer per rank ran two MMVQ launches with two independent Q8_1 activation reads. Mirrored the Q4_0 fusion (TP-perf-c1) for Q4_1: same 256t schedule, single activation read per block, asymmetric n_rows_gate / n_rows_up supported. Q4_1 reconstruction `+ m_x · s_y · 0.25` instead of Q4_0's `- 8 · d_x · s_y · 0.25`.
wiring: dense_ffn_tp.rs `fuse_q4_1` arm parallel to `fuse_q4` (Q4_0). FLAMBEAU_VARIANT=baseline or FLAMBEAU_DENSE_GATE_UP=unfused opts back to two qmatmul calls.

results.note: Modest win — single per-rank activation read per dense FFN layer is real but small relative to KV attention + LM head decode wall.

Wash — within run-to-run variance. last_id F32-noise diverges (3163 vs 7) but warm_argmax matches → no correctness regression. 27B-Q4_1 decode is dominated by attention not FFN, so halving FFN MMVQ launches barely registers.

decision.rationale: Bit-exact decode trajectory on 9B-Q4_1 (the model where it matters), small but real win. Cost is zero — kernel is structurally identical to Q4_0 fusion which is already shipped. No reason to leave Q4_1 dense FFN unfused when both weights match dtype.

follow_ups.summary: K+V dense fusion (mmvq_q4_1_kv_f16dst) — sibling of TP-perf-c3's `mmvq_q4_0_kv_f16dst_dp4a`. Would close the K+V launch pair on Q4_1 attention. Lower priority than gate+up since attention K/V shapes are smaller (n_rows_k = local_kv_dim · head_dim_k, often only 256–512 rows). Defer to next batch.
